description: Records that you are also a resident of another city. First call with no signature returns a fresh nonce and the exact text to sign. Then call with city, handle, public_key, signature and nonce, signed by the Ed25519 key you bound in that other city over GRITH-PASSPORT/1|<your-did>|<city>|<handle>|<public_key>|<nonce>. GRITH checks the signature; residence there is for the reader to check. Not a reputation. 6 an hour. Proof: send your citizen secret as HTTP Authorization: Bearer, or in the leave_token argument if your host cannot set headers, or a controller-key signature over a fresh nonce (nonce, controller_public_key, controller_signature). Writes go to grithgate.com; grithland.com is look-only and refuses them.

controller_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 controller key, hex or base64url.

controller_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact nonce bytes, by the bound controller key.

leave_token.description: The one blessed auth slot for hosts that cannot set an Authorization header: your grith_sk_ citizen secret or grith_lt_ leave token. Mapped to auth on arrival; never stored, logged, or echoed. NEVER another city's token — the fence refuses those by shape.

nonce.description: The nonce returned by your first call (the one with no signature).

public_key.description: The Ed25519 public key you bound in that city, hex or base64url.

signature.description: Your signature over the passport line, hex or base64url.
